name: metric
summary: Presents a formatted operational value with optional context, trend, and decorative icon.

agent.useWhen: A summary needs a primary formatted operational value with optional supporting context and a directional change.
agent.avoidWhen: The value belongs in a data-table cell, needs a chart to explain it, or requires live browser state or interaction.

invariants: Label and formatted value are required nonblank text; values remain app-formatted text and are never parsed or localized by the component.

Trend direction and favorability tone are independent. trend, trendTone, and trendLabel must be supplied together; trendAnnouncement may override the English accessible default only when a trend exists.
Direction and tone are named in screen-reader text before the visible escaped trend label. Trend glyphs and optional closed-catalog leading icons are decorative; no live region is created.
All supplied text is nonblank and contains no control characters; all text is HTML-escaped and unknown properties are rejected.
Optional icon names must exist in the package's closed icons.json catalog. Trend glyphs use the catalog arrow-up, arrow-down, and minus icons.
The fragment has exactly one [[metric]] slot; inserted user text is never interpreted as template syntax.
The metric is static and noninteractive, with no browser-local state, events, scripts, or numeric conversion. The app owns domain state and rerender timing.
